title: WEATHER FORECAST FOR 25 JULY 2026 Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 24 July 2026 A few showers will occur in the Western, Sabaragamuwa and North-western provinces and in Galle and Matara districts. Mainly dry weather will prevail over the other areas of the island. Fairly strong winds about (30-40) kmph can be expected at times over Northern and North-central provinces and in Hambantota, Trincomalee and Puttalam districts.
